heroSub: Flexible rates, a real London location, and a stay that's actually looked after.
introHeadline: Flexible rates, a great location, and a bed you'll actually sleep well in.
about1: We bring a level of care and attention to detail that larger operators simply can't match. Every property is personally managed to hotel-quality standards, and every guest has direct access to responsive, 24-hour support.
about2: We handle everything in-house, from meticulous property presentation to seamless digital check-in, so guests can expect a smooth, well-communicated stay from booking to check-out. Our focus is on being a genuine home away from home: comfortable, reliable, and consistently well cared for.

units.name: New Guest favourite 1-Bed Flat
units.desc: Settle into a modern South London flat with a private, fully fenced garden — an inviting spot to unwind after a day in the city. A bright main living/sleeping area pairs with a separate kitchen and modern bathroom, presented to a high standard for stays short or long.
